# Model Prompt Lab

A Muse agent skill for production prompt engineering: build production system prompts, migrate prompts between models, diagnose misbehaving prompts (duplication first, subtract before adding), design reproducible prompt benchmarks, and work a disciplined "Fable mode" process for hard messy problems. Model profiles are dated and must be source-verified against the owning docs before use; benchmarks produce plans and ledgers, never claimed results. Ported from a community plugin.
